correctness.rationale: For every triangle- and square-free graph, two positive answers reduce a center family to either a singleton or a star with no further binary split of size at least two on both sides; hence Ldim<=3. The first-positive family consists of two stars, so maximum degree three yields Ldim<=2. Ldim three requires a degree-four endpoint adjacent to degree-two, yielding two shattered fixed edge queries and hence the sharp one-unit gap. Explicit tree incidence matrix and depth-three witness replay correctly; the eight-edge count proves minimal tree order nine. Finite code corroborates rather than substitutes for infinite proof.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a sharp uniform online stability bound and one-bit VC/Littlestone gap across the infinite class of girth-five graphs, detects the exact local-degree threshold for depth-three online shattering, and identifies the smallest realizing tree by structural necessity plus a finite witness. The girth obstruction removes the four-cycle endpoint crossing responsible for higher adaptive complexity; this is not a routine specialization of the known complete-line-graph bound four.
